meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用语法树精准搜索和改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多语言项目中按代码结构而非文本进行搜索和替换
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree precisely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and replace code by structure across multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按代码结构（而非文字）搜索和改写 25 种语言的代码。它可查找特定函数、调用、类等模式，执行自动替换（先预览再应用）。Claude 会先验证模式语法，只应用确认过的修改。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及代码结构（如查找特定形状的函数、类、调用、导入）的搜索或重写任务时触发。例如“找出所有接受 Request 参数的函数”或“把 console.log 改成 logger.info”。

say.text: 帮我把项目中所有的 console.log 替换成 logger.info。
say.note: 先预览改动，确认后执行。

say.text: 找出所有空 catch 块的代码。
say.note: 返回匹配的文件和位置。

say.text: 运行预设的 YAML 代码规则，检查问题。
say.note: 扫描整个项目并输出报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and rewrite code across 25 languages by structure rather than text. It can find patterns like functions, calls, classes, etc., perform replacements (preview first, then apply), and validate patterns before execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for structural code searches or rewrites, such as finding all functions accepting a Request parameter or replacing console.log with logger.info.

say_en.text: Replace all console.log with logger.info in the project.
Run the predefined YAML code rules to check issues.
say_en.note: Scans the whole project and outputs a report.
